title: wg: combiner-02 L683 The mode 1 claim of 'PQ/T update authenticity' does not say that it...
description:
draft-ietf-mls-combiner (combiner-02), Security Considerations / FULL Commit Frequency. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-combiner at 380f0e1, L683.

Text: "frequent FULL Commits, the latter case would enable general PQ/T"

Problem: The mode 1 claim of 'PQ/T update authenticity' does not say that it covers only FULL Commits. PARTIAL Commits exist only in the T session and carry only traditional signatures in every mode.

Suggested fix: Say that PQ/T update authenticity applies to FULL Commits, and that PARTIAL Commits have traditional authenticity only.

Severity: low. Verifier: narrow (The text at lines 677-682 already says 'traditional update authenticity' for the PARTIAL-heavy case, so the gap is only the unqualified mode 1 claim at lines 682-685. PARTIAL Commits can still occur there, and they carry only traditional signatures.)

From MLS audit workflow wf_581e61f8-b25 (2026-10-21). Not yet reviewed by Mark; nothing posted upstream.
